pages.title: Writing Guide

content.text: GUIDE TO WRITING A SHORT STORY ABOUT AN ANIMAL AFFECTED BY LIGHT POLLUTION (Around 200 words)
HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT TRUYỆN NGẮN VỀ ĐỘNG VẬT BỊ ẢNH HƯỞNG BỞI Ô NHIỄM ÁNH SÁNG (Khoảng 200 từ)

items: Select an animal that is affected by light pollution (Chọn một loài động vật bị ảnh hưởng bởi ô nhiễm ánh sáng)
Give your character a name (Đặt tên cho nhân vật của bạn)
Describe their physical appearance and personality (Mô tả ngoại hình và tính cách của chúng)
Explain their natural behaviors and habitat (Giải thích hành vi tự nhiên và môi trường sống của chúng)
Sea turtle hatchling (Rùa biển con mới nở): crawls toward city lights instead of the ocean
Migratory bird (Chim di cư): becomes disorientated during night flights
Owl (Cú): struggles to hunt because prey hides from bright lights
Firefly (Đom đóm): can't find a mate because their light signals are invisible
Bat (Dơi): has difficulty foraging for insects in lit areas

content.text: Character Description Examples: (Ví dụ miêu tả nhân vật:)

items: Luna was a small sea turtle hatchling...
Stella, a young barn owl, had golden eyes...
Flash was a tiny firefly who loved to dance...
Describe the natural habitat before light pollution (Mô tả môi trường sống tự nhiên trước khi có ô nhiễm ánh sáng)
Show what the environment was like in the past (Cho thấy môi trường như thế nào trong quá khứ)
Use sensory details (sight, sound, smell) (Sử dụng chi tiết cảm giác - thị giác, thính giác, khứu giác)
Create a peaceful, natural atmosphere (Tạo bầu không khí yên bình, tự nhiên)
For generations, Luna's family had nested on the dark, peaceful beach. The only lights were the stars and the soft ocean glow.
The forest had always been Stella's hunting ground. In the darkness, she could hear every sound.
The meadow was once filled with dancing fireflies, their gentle lights blinking in the warm night.
Show how light pollution arrives (new streetlights, billboards, buildings) (Cho thấy ô nhiễm ánh sáng xuất hiện như thế nào - đèn đường mới, biển quảng cáo, tòa nhà)
Describe the change in the environment (Mô tả sự thay đổi trong môi trường)
Use vocabulary about light pollution (Sử dụng từ vựng về ô nhiễm ánh sáng)
Show the immediate impact on your character (Cho thấy tác động ngay lập tức đến nhân vật của bạn)
But one night, everything changed. Bright streetlights appeared. Glaring billboards lit up the sky. The darkness was replaced by artificial light.
The city expanded. Excessive over-illumination created a constant skyglow.
New LED lights disrupted the natural rhythm of the ecosystem.
Describe how your character tries to survive (Mô tả cách nhân vật cố gắng sinh tồn)
Show their confusion and difficulties (Cho thấy sự bối rối và khó khăn của chúng)
Include specific challenges related to light pollution (Bao gồm những thử thách cụ thể liên quan đến ô nhiễm ánh sáng)
Make the reader feel empathy for the character (Làm cho người đọc cảm thông với nhân vật)
Luna felt disorientated. She crawled toward the city lights instead of the ocean.
Stella's prey stayed hidden. Night after night, she went hungry.
Flash's small light was invisible against the glaring streetlights.
Introduce hope or help (maybe humans realize the problem) (Đưa ra hy vọng hoặc sự giúp đỡ - có thể con người nhận ra vấn đề)
Show a solution being implemented (Cho thấy giải pháp được thực hiện)
Describe positive changes (Mô tả những thay đổi tích cực)
Keep it realistic and educational (Giữ nó thực tế và mang tính giáo dục)
Students learned about light pollution. They convinced the city to install shielded lighting.
Scientists created a dark-sky preserve in the forest.
The community raised awareness. People started turning off unnecessary lights.
Show how the solution helps your character (Cho thấy giải pháp giúp nhân vật của bạn như thế nào)
End with hope for the future (Kết thúc với hy vọng cho tương lai)
Include a message about protecting wildlife (Bao gồm thông điệp về bảo vệ động vật hoang dã)
Make it memorable and meaningful (Làm cho nó đáng nhớ và ý nghĩa)
The next year, baby turtles found their way to the ocean safely.
Stella could hunt again. The ecosystem returned to its natural rhythm.
Fireflies danced once more in the meadow. Flash had found his light.

rows:
Introduce character and habitat
Giới thiệu nhân vật và môi trường

Light pollution arrives
Ô nhiễm ánh sáng xuất hiện

Character faces challenges
Nhân vật đối mặt thử thách

Help arrives, changes happen
Có sự giúp đỡ, thay đổi xảy ra

Hope and message
Hy vọng và thông điệp

content.text: 8. Vocabulary to Use in Your Story

items: Light sources: artificial light, streetlights, billboards, skyglow
Light descriptions: excessive, glaring, brightness, over-illumination
Animal behaviors: navigation, foraging, disorientated, disrupts
Environment: ecosystem, wildlife, natural rhythm, urban areas
Effects: fatal, light trespass, stellar light, visibility
Solutions: shielded lighting, dark-sky preserves, sustainable, mitigate
Use descriptive language to paint pictures in the reader's mind
Show emotions - make readers care about your animal character
Include sensory details (what the character sees, hears, feels)
Use dialogue if appropriate (animals talking or humans discussing)
Incorporate vocabulary from the reading lesson naturally
Balance the problem with hope - don't make it too sad
Make your message clear but not preachy
Edit and proofread your story carefully

Better: 'The excessive brightness of the new LED streetlights flooded the beach, creating a harsh glaring light that washed away the gentle glow of the stars.' (instead of 'The lights were very bright.')
Better: 'Luna felt disorientated, her tiny flippers carrying her in circles as the artificial lights confused her natural navigation instincts.' (instead of 'Luna was confused.')
Better: 'The constant skyglow disrupted the natural rhythm of the forest, turning peaceful darkness into an orange haze that never faded.' (instead of 'The sky was always bright.')
Better: 'Flash's bioluminescent glow, once special and magical, became invisible against the glaring billboards.' (instead of 'No one could see Flash's light.')
Better: 'With the implementation of shielded lighting, darkness slowly returned to the beach like an old friend coming home.' (instead of 'The beach got dark again.')

content.text: Truyện mẫu: Hành trình về nhà của Luna

Luna was a tiny sea turtle hatchling who had just broken free from her sandy nest on a peaceful Vietnamese beach. For generations, her family had followed the stellar light reflected on the ocean to reach the safety of the sea.

But everything changed when a new resort was built. Bright streetlights and glaring billboards created excessive artificial light. The over-illumination turned the night sky orange with constant skyglow.

When Luna emerged from her nest, she felt disorientated. The brightness disrupted her natural navigation instincts. Instead of crawling toward the ocean, she headed toward the city lights. Many of her siblings faced the same fatal confusion, crawling toward the urban area instead of the sea.

Fortunately, local students had been learning about light pollution. They convinced the resort to install shielded lighting that points downward and to turn off unnecessary lights during nesting season. The community worked together to raise awareness and create a dark-sky preserve along the beach.

The next year, baby turtles found their way to the ocean safely. The beach had returned to its natural darkness. Luna's story reminded everyone that we must control light pollution to protect wildlife and the environment. Small changes can make a big difference.
